meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为电商商品写图片文案:先向你收集产品名称、卖点、目标用户等信息,再产出带 emoji 的标题和四段式正文(痛点、产品、卖点、情感),也能优化已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji,输出 Markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求时触发,比如需要为某类商品生成电商营销图片文案,或修改已有文案的标题、正文。

say.text: 帮我为智能睡眠眼罩写一条电商文案,卖点是科学遮光和智能感应
say.note: 会按模板产出带 emoji 的标题和四段正文。

say.text: 优化这条充电宝文案的标题,加个产品昵称和 emoji
say.note: 会返回改写后的标题和正文。

say.text: 给可降解餐具写文案,目标用户是注重环保的年轻人
say.note: 会先确认产品信息再输出 Markdown 文案。

howto.what_en: Claude writes e-commerce image copy: collects product details, outputs an emoji title plus a four-part body (pain point, product, selling points, emotional close), and revises existing titles and copy in Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, such as generating marketing image copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for a smart sleep mask, selling points: light blocking and smart sensing
say_en.note: Gives an emoji title and four-part body.

say_en.text: Improve the title of this power bank copy: add a product nickname and emoji
say_en.note: Returns a revised title and body.

say_en.text: Write copy for biodegradable tableware, aimed at eco-minded young buyers
say_en.note: Confirms product info, then outputs Markdown copy.
